text: ポケモンを　けんきゅう　しつくした　ぼくに　かてるかい！

structure.jp: ポケモンを　けんきゅう　しつくした　ぼくに
structure.en: against me, who has researched Pokémon to the limit

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ポケモンを　けんきゅう　しつくした　ぼく
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb sits before a word and describes it, even when that word is 'me'. ポケモンを けんきゅう しつくした ぼく = 'me, who has researched Pokémon completely'.

patterns.name: 〜つくす
patterns.explanation: つくす added to a verb means doing it until nothing is left to do. けんきゅう しつくした = 'researched everything there is'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: かてる is the 'can' form of かつ, 'to win'. ぼくに かてるかい = 'can you beat me?'
